objectives.en: I can talk about my plans with going to: I'm going to apply for a job.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת לדבר על התוכניות שלי עם going to, למשל: I'm going to apply for a job.

objectives.en: I can use will for decisions I make now, offers and promises.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להשתמש ב-will להחלטות של הרגע, להצעות ולהבטחות.

objectives.en: I can make predictions with will and going to.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת לחזות מה יקרה בעזרת will ו-going to.

warmup.en: Two situations: last week you bought a ticket to Berlin, and now a friend asks about your summer; or right now a friend says 'I'm cold!' What do you say in each case?
warmup.he: שני מצבים: בשבוע שעבר קניתם כרטיס לברלין, ועכשיו חבר שואל מה התוכניות שלכם לקיץ; או שממש עכשיו חבר אומר לכם 'קר לי!'. מה תגידו בכל מקרה? באנגלית התשובה תלויה ברגע שבו קיבלתם את ההחלטה.

explanation.en: Compare: I'm going to visit Berlin in May. (I decided this before: it's my plan.) · You're cold? I'll close the window. (I'm deciding right now.)
explanation.he: השוו: I'm going to visit Berlin in May – החלטתי מראש, זו התוכנית שלי. ‏You're cold? I'll close the window – אני מחליט/ה עכשיו, ברגע הדיבור.

rows: We're going to move to Haifa in the summer.
Prediction: I can see it now
Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
Decision at the moment of speaking
The phone's ringing. I'll get it.
I'll help you. I won't tell anyone.
I think you'll love the film.

explanation.en: will is the same for every person, and the base verb follows it: she will go (not *she wills go, not *will to go). Negative: won't = will not.
explanation.he: will זהה בכל הגופים, ואחריו בא פועל בצורת הבסיס: she will go (לא wills ולא will to go). בשלילה: won't = will not.

explanation.en: going to needs am, is or are: I'm going to call her (not *I going to call her).
explanation.he: לפני going to חייבים am, is או are: I'm going to call her ולא I going to call her.

explanation.en: In Hebrew the same future form can describe a plan and a sudden decision. In English, ask yourself: did I decide before (going to) or right now (will)?
explanation.he: בעברית אותה צורת עתיד ('אני אתקשר אליה') מתאימה גם לתוכנית וגם להחלטה של רגע. באנגלית שאלו את עצמכם: החלטתי לפני כן (going to) או ממש עכשיו (will)?

explanation.en: In fast speech going to often sounds like 'gonna'. You'll hear it everywhere, but write going to.
explanation.he: בדיבור מהיר going to נשמע הרבה פעמים כמו gonna. תשמעו את זה בכל מקום, אבל בכתיבה כתבו going to.

examples.en: I'm going to start a new course in October.
examples.he: אני מתכוון/ת להתחיל קורס חדש באוקטובר.

examples.en: Look at the sky. It's going to rain.
examples.he: תסתכלו על השמיים, עוד מעט יירד גשם.

examples.en: Are you going to buy a ticket?
We aren't going to stay long.
examples.he: אנחנו לא מתכוונים להישאר הרבה זמן.

examples.en: That bag looks heavy. I'll carry it.
examples.he: התיק הזה נראה כבד. אני אקח אותו.

examples.en: I'll call you tonight, I promise.
Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.
examples.he: אל דאגה, לא אספר לאף אחד.

examples.en: I think Maya will love this present.
examples.he: נראה לי שמאיה תאהב את המתנה הזאת.

vocab.def: to want something to happen and think that it is possible
vocab.example: I hope you'll like the present.
I'll definitely come to your party.

vocab.def: to say that you will certainly do something
vocab.example: I promise I'll be on time.

vocab.def: to say that you are happy to do something for someone or give them something
vocab.example: Amir offered to drive us home.

vocab.def: to choose what to do after thinking about it
to keep money so that you can use it later
vocab.example: I'm going to save money for a car.

vocab.def: to ask in writing for a job, a course or a place at university
vocab.example: Noa is going to apply for a job at the hospital.

vocab.def: a report that says what the weather will be like
vocab.example: The weather forecast says it will be sunny.
Lior is going to study abroad next year.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew there is no present-tense 'be', so am/is/are can disappear before going to. English needs it: I'm going to call her (not *I going to call her).
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית אין 'להיות' בהווה, ולכן קל להשמיט את am/is/are לפני going to. באנגלית חייבים אותו: I'm going to call her.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew a question can keep the word order of a statement. In a normal English question, am/is/are or will comes before the subject: Are you going to come? Will you help me? (You're going to come? only shows surprise.)
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית שאלה יכולה לשמור על סדר המילים של משפט רגיל ('אתה הולך לבוא?'). בשאלה רגילה באנגלית am/is/are או will באים לפני הנושא: Are you going to come? Will you help me? (You're going to come? מביע רק הפתעה.)

prompt.en: Plan or decision now? Decide which form fits each gap.
prompt.he: תוכנית או החלטה של רגע? החליטו איזו צורה מתאימה לכל רווח.

items.text: We booked the hotel last month. We ___ stay in Rome for three nights.
I don't have a pen for the test! – Don't worry, I ___ lend you one.
I saved for two years. I ___ buy a car this summer.
The phone's ringing. – OK, I ___ answer it.
Maya decided in March: she ___ study law.
This box is so heavy! – Wait, I ___ help you.

hint.en: Look for clues. booked, saved, decided = before. Don't worry, OK, Wait = now.
hint.he: חפשו רמזים. booked, saved, decided = החלטה מראש. Don't worry, OK, Wait = החלטה עכשיו.

explanation.en: If the decision was made before (booked, saved, decided), use going to. If the speaker decides at that moment, often to help someone (Don't worry / OK / Wait), use will.
explanation.he: אם ההחלטה התקבלה מראש (booked, saved, decided) – going to. אם הדובר מחליט באותו רגע, הרבה פעמים כדי לעזור (Don't worry / OK / Wait) – will.

prompt.en: Listen and choose the sentence you hear.

exercises.audio_text: I'll call you when I get home.
exercises.question: What did you hear?
options: I call you when I get home.
I'll call you when I get home.
I called you when I got home.

0.en: Listen again for the 'll: I'll sounds like /aɪl/, with an l at the end.
0.he: הקשיבו שוב ל-'ll: ‏I'll נשמע /aɪl/, עם l בסוף.

2.en: The sentence is about the future (when I get home), not the past.
2.he: המשפט מדבר על העתיד (when I get home), לא על העבר.

explanation.en: I'll = I will: a promise about the future. The short form is very common and easy to miss, so listen for the /l/.
explanation.he: I'll = I will: הבטחה לגבי העתיד. הצורה המקוצרת נפוצה מאוד וקל לפספס אותה, אז הקשיבו ל-/l/.

0.en: going to needs is: It's (It is) going to rain.
0.he: לפני going to צריך is: ‏It's going to rain.

1.en: There is no to after will. And when you can see the evidence now, going to is the natural choice.
1.he: אחרי will לא בא to. וכשרואים את הסימנים עכשיו, going to היא הבחירה הטבעית.

3.en: Don't drop the to: going to rain.
3.he: אל תשמיטו את ה-to: going to rain.

explanation.en: A prediction from what you can see now: be + going to + base verb.
explanation.he: תחזית לפי מה שרואים עכשיו: be + going to + צורת הבסיס.

prompt.en: Complete with going to and the verb in brackets.
prompt.he: השלימו עם going to והפועל שבסוגריים.

exercises.text: Noa ___ (study) law at university in October. Her parents ___ (not / move) to Tel Aviv with her.
answers: is going to study
's going to study
aren't going to move
're not going to move

feedback.en: Don't forget is: Noa is going to study.
feedback.he: חסר is: ‏Noa is going to study.

feedback.en: After going to, use the base form: study.
feedback.he: אחרי going to באה צורת הבסיס: study.

feedback.en: Noa has a plan for October, and the task asks for going to: is going to study.
feedback.he: לנועה יש תוכנית לאוקטובר, והמשימה מבקשת going to: ‏is going to study.

feedback.en: Use going to, as the task asks: aren't going to move.
feedback.he: השתמשו ב-going to, כמו שהמשימה מבקשת: aren't going to move.

feedback.en: Add are: Her parents aren't going to move.
feedback.he: חסר are: ‏Her parents aren't going to move.

feedback.en: Her parents = they, so use aren't.
feedback.he: Her parents = they, ולכן aren't.

feedback.en: Put not right after are: aren't going to move.
feedback.he: ה-not בא מיד אחרי are: ‏aren't going to move.

hint.en: Noa = she → is. Her parents = they → are.
hint.he: Noa = she, ולכן is. ‏Her parents = they, ולכן are.

explanation.en: be + going to + base verb. Noa is going to study; her parents aren't going to move.
explanation.he: be + going to + צורת הבסיס: Noa is going to study, ובשלילה: her parents aren't going to move.

prompt.en: Complete with will or won't and the verb in brackets.
prompt.he: השלימו עם will או won't והפועל שבסוגריים.

exercises.text: Don't worry, I ___ (not / tell) anyone about the surprise party. And I ___ (help) you with the food tomorrow.
answers: won't tell
will help
'll help

feedback.en: don't tell is present simple (a habit). For a promise about the future, use won't tell.
feedback.he: don't tell זה הווה פשוט (הרגל). להבטחה לעתיד משתמשים ב-won't tell.

feedback.en: No to after won't: won't tell.
feedback.he: אחרי won't לא בא to: ‏won't tell.

feedback.en: No to after will: will help.
feedback.he: אחרי will לא בא to: ‏will help.

feedback.en: will + base verb, with no -s: will help.
feedback.he: will + צורת הבסיס, בלי s: will help.

explanation.en: Promises and offers use will / won't + base verb: I won't tell anyone. I'll help you.
explanation.he: הבטחות והצעות: will או won't + צורת הבסיס. I won't tell anyone. I'll help you.

prompt.en: Choose the best answer for B.
prompt.he: בחרו את התשובה המתאימה ביותר ל-B.

exercises.question: A: Oh no, there's no milk for the coffee! B: Really? OK, ___ some from the shop.

0.en: The present simple is for habits, not for a decision about the next few minutes.
0.he: הווה פשוט מתאר הרגלים, לא החלטה לגבי הדקות הקרובות.

1.en: going to is for a plan made before. B says 'Really?', so B didn't know and is deciding now: I'll get.
1.he: going to מתאים לתוכנית שנקבעה מראש. B אומר 'Really?', כלומר לא ידע, ומחליט עכשיו: I'll get.

2.en: I got is past, but B is talking about what to do next.
2.he: I got זה עבר, אבל B מדבר על מה שיעשה עכשיו.

explanation.en: A decision made at the moment of speaking → will: I'll get some.
explanation.he: החלטה שמתקבלת ברגע הדיבור → will: I'll get some.

prompt.en: Read Amir's post and answer the questions.
prompt.he: קראו את הפוסט של אמיר וענו על השאלות.

exercises.title: After the army: my plan
exercises.passage:
In March my army service will finally be over, and everyone asks me about my plans. So here they are.
First, I'm going to work for four months. My uncle has a small restaurant in Haifa, and I'm going to help in the kitchen. I want to save as much money as I can. Then I'm going to travel. My friend Lior and I are going to spend three months in South America. We don't have our plane tickets yet, but we're going to buy them soon.
After that? I think I'll study computer science, but I'm not sure. My mum says I'll change my mind ten times before October. She's probably right!
To my friends: don't worry, I won't disappear. I promise I'll post photos every week.
– Amir

questions.statement: Amir is going to start university in March.

explanation.en: In March his army service will be over. Then he's going to work and travel.
explanation.he: במרץ השירות הצבאי שלו ייגמר. אחרי זה הוא מתכנן לעבוד ולטייל.

questions.question: Where is Amir going to work?
options: in a hotel in South America

1.en: In South America he's going to travel, not work.
1.he: בדרום אמריקה הוא מתכנן לטייל, לא לעבוד.

2.en: Computer science is maybe for later, at university.
2.he: מדעי המחשב הם אולי בהמשך, באוניברסיטה.

explanation.en: 'My uncle has a small restaurant in Haifa, and I'm going to help in the kitchen.'
explanation.he: בטקסט: My uncle has a small restaurant in Haifa, and I'm going to help in the kitchen.

questions.statement: Amir and Lior already have their plane tickets.

explanation.en: 'We don't have our plane tickets yet, but we're going to buy them soon.'
explanation.he: בטקסט: We don't have our plane tickets yet – עוד אין להם כרטיסים.

questions.question: Amir writes 'I think I'll study computer science'. Why does he use will here?
options: It's a fixed plan with a date.
It's a decision he made years ago.
He isn't sure: it's an opinion about the future.

0.en: He says 'I'm not sure', so it isn't a fixed plan.
0.he: הוא כותב I'm not sure, כך שזו לא תוכנית סגורה.

1.en: For a decision made long ago he would use going to.
1.he: להחלטה שהתקבלה מזמן הוא היה משתמש ב-going to.

explanation.en: I think + will is for opinions and predictions. Amir isn't sure yet.
explanation.he: I think + will משמש לדעה או לתחזית. אמיר עוד לא בטוח.

questions.text: Amir promises that he ___ post photos every week.
answers: will
'll
is going to

explanation.en: 'I promise I'll post photos every week.' Promises use will.
explanation.he: בטקסט: I promise I'll post photos every week. בהבטחות משתמשים ב-will.

prompt.en: Kenji has a plan. Write a sentence about it with going to.
prompt.he: לקנג'י יש תוכנית. כתבו עליה משפט עם going to.

exercises.source: Kenji's plan: see his grandparents this weekend
answers: Kenji is going to see his grandparents this weekend.
Kenji's going to see his grandparents this weekend.
This weekend Kenji is going to see his grandparents.
This weekend, Kenji is going to see his grandparents.
This weekend Kenji's going to see his grandparents.
This weekend, Kenji's going to see his grandparents.
He is going to see his grandparents this weekend.
This weekend he is going to see his grandparents.
This weekend, he is going to see his grandparents.
Kenji is going to visit his grandparents this weekend.
Kenji's going to visit his grandparents this weekend.
This weekend Kenji is going to visit his grandparents.
This weekend, Kenji is going to visit his grandparents.

wrong_feedback.match: Kenji going to see his grandparents this weekend.

feedback.en: going to needs is: Kenji is going to see...
feedback.he: לפני going to צריך is: ‏Kenji is going to see...

wrong_feedback.match: Kenji is going to sees his grandparents this weekend.

feedback.en: After going to, use the base form: see.
feedback.he: אחרי going to באה צורת הבסיס: see.

wrong_feedback.match: Kenji is going see his grandparents this weekend.

feedback.en: Don't drop the to: going to see.
feedback.he: אל תשמיטו את ה-to: going to see.

wrong_feedback.match: Kenji will see his grandparents this weekend.

feedback.en: That's correct English, but the task asks for going to, and for a plan made before, going to is the most natural choice.
feedback.he: זה משפט תקין, אבל המשימה מבקשת going to, ולתוכנית שנקבעה מראש going to היא הבחירה הטבעית ביותר.

explanation.en: Plan → subject + am/is/are + going to + base verb: Kenji is going to see his grandparents.
explanation.he: תוכנית → נושא + am/is/are + going to + צורת הבסיס: Kenji is going to see his grandparents.

exercises.sentence: She will to call you later.
answers: She will call you later.

explanation.en: After will, use the base verb with no to: She'll call you later.
explanation.he: אחרי will בא פועל בצורת הבסיס, בלי to: She'll call you later.

prompt.en: One word is missing. Write the sentence correctly.
prompt.he: חסרה מילה אחת. כתבו את המשפט נכון.

exercises.sentence: I going to buy a new laptop next week.
answers: I am going to buy a new laptop next week.

hint.en: What always comes before going to?
hint.he: מה תמיד בא לפני going to?

explanation.en: going to always needs am/is/are: I'm going to buy...
explanation.he: לפני going to תמיד יש am/is/are: I'm going to buy...

prompt.en: Put the words in order to make a question.

explanation.en: In a question, are comes before the subject: Are you going to apply for the job?
explanation.he: בשאלה are בא לפני הנושא: Are you going to apply for the job?

exercises.source: אני הולכת ללמוד רפואה בשנה הבאה.
answers: I'm going to study medicine next year.
Next year I'm going to study medicine.
Next year, I'm going to study medicine.
I will study medicine next year.
Next year I will study medicine.
Next year, I will study medicine.

wrong_feedback.match: I going to study medicine next year.

feedback.en: Add am: I'm going to study... going to always needs am/is/are.
feedback.he: חסר am: ‏I'm going to study. לפני going to תמיד יש am/is/are.

wrong_feedback.match: I go to study medicine next year.

feedback.en: Here the idea is a plan for the future, not walking somewhere. I go to... describes a habit. Write: I'm going to study...
feedback.he: כאן 'הולכת ל...' היא תוכנית לעתיד, לא הליכה. ‏I go to... מתאר הרגל. כתבו: I'm going to study...

feedback.en: For a subject at university, English uses study. learn is for skills: learn to drive, learn English.
feedback.he: ל'ללמוד' יש שתי מילים באנגלית: study למקצוע באוניברסיטה, ו-learn למיומנות (learn to drive).

wrong_feedback.match: I'm going to study medicine the next year.

feedback.en: No the before next year: I'm going to study medicine next year.
feedback.he: לפני next year לא בא the: ‏next year.

wrong_feedback.match: I'm going to study medicine in the next year.

feedback.en: Just say next year, with no in and no the: I'm going to study medicine next year.
feedback.he: אומרים פשוט next year, בלי in ובלי the: ‏I'm going to study medicine next year.

hint.en: Think about two verbs: study and learn. Which one do we use for a university subject?
hint.he: יש שני פעלים: study ו-learn. באיזה מהם משתמשים למקצוע באוניברסיטה?

explanation.en: Two traps: this plan needs am (I'm going to...), and for a university subject English uses study, not learn.
explanation.he: שתי מלכודות: לתוכנית צריך am (I'm going to...), ול'ללמוד' מקצוע באוניברסיטה אומרים study ולא learn.

exercises.audio_text: It's going to be cold tonight, so I'll take a jacket.
answers: It's going to be cold tonight, so I'll take a jacket.

hint.en: There are two future forms: a prediction and a decision.
hint.he: יש במשפט שתי צורות עתיד: תחזית והחלטה.

explanation.en: It's going to be cold = a prediction (maybe from the forecast). I'll take = a decision now.
explanation.he: It's going to be cold = תחזית (אולי לפי התחזית במזג האוויר). ‏I'll take = החלטה של עכשיו.

exercises.target: I'm going to call her tonight. I'll tell you what she says.

focus.en: going ends in /ŋ/: no hard g at the end. I'll sounds like /aɪl/.
focus.he: going מסתיים ב-/ŋ/, בלי g חזקה בסוף. ‏I'll נשמע /aɪl/.

explanation.en: A plan (going to) and a promise (will) together: very natural in everyday conversation.
explanation.he: תוכנית (going to) והבטחה (will) ביחד – שילוב טבעי מאוד בשיחה יומיומית.

prompt.en: Write a message about your plans.

task.en: Write a message to a friend (50-90 words). Tell them three plans for next weekend or the summer (going to). Then make one prediction and one offer or promise with will or won't.
task.he: כתבו הודעה לחבר או לחברה (50-90 מילים). ספרו על שלוש תוכניות לסוף השבוע הבא או לקיץ (going to). אחר כך כתבו תחזית אחת, והצעה או הבטחה אחת עם will או won't.

exercises.model_answer: Hi Daniel! Big news: I'm going to visit my cousins in London in August. We're going to see a musical, and I'm going to try fish and chips for the first time. I think it will rain every day, but I don't care! I'll bring you something from London. What would you like? And don't worry, I won't forget your birthday this time. See you soon, Yael

checklist.en: I wrote three plans with am/is/are + going to + base verb.
checklist.he: כתבתי שלוש תוכניות עם am/is/are + going to + צורת הבסיס.

checklist.en: I made one prediction with will (I think it will...).
checklist.he: כתבתי תחזית אחת עם will (I think it will...).

checklist.en: I made an offer or a promise with will or won't.
checklist.he: כתבתי הצעה או הבטחה עם will או won't.

checklist.en: No to after will: I'll bring (not *I'll to bring).
checklist.he: אחרי will אין to: I'll bring ולא I'll to bring.

key_points.en: Plans made before: am/is/are + going to + base verb.
key_points.he: תוכניות שנקבעו מראש: am/is/are + going to + צורת הבסיס.

key_points.en: Predictions from what you can see now: It's going to rain.
key_points.he: תחזית לפי מה שרואים עכשיו: It's going to rain.

key_points.en: will ('ll) for decisions now, offers, promises and opinions: I'll help you.
key_points.he: will ('ll) להחלטה של רגע, הצעה, הבטחה ודעה: I'll help you.

key_points.en: won't = will not. No to after will: I'll call (not *I'll to call).
key_points.he: won't = will not. אחרי will אין to: I'll call ולא I'll to call.
